 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.613/2022, registered at Police Station-Kolar Road, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) of IPC and section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is young boy aged about 20 years.
Applicant and prosecutrix was have consensual relationship with the applicant.
He did not know that prosecutrix was minor.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
